_comment: Bound for the end-to-end character-error-rate check (tests/test_e2e.py), measured with ocr_eval.py (dash kinds folded, display formulas skipped; see the README 'Tuning notes'). It applies only to the document and pages below, run with the default options of each Reader (Judge on, default threshold, 216 DPI): with another PDF or other pages the check is skipped unless PDF_OCR_CER_BOUND is set. Rule for the bound: measured error rate + 0.05 percentage points, rounded up to the next 0.05 percentage points. This is NOT the original 21-page sample (sha256 92edbf79...), which is not available; numbers here are not comparable with the earlier 0.40 % figure.

document.name: 台灣人壽解約金 115.09.23.pdf
document.note: Traditional Chinese insurance disclosure with a full text layer, mostly numeric tables. Not committed (gitignored); the person running the tests supplies it with PDF_OCR_SAMPLE_PDF.

measured._comment: Default options of each Reader, RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 2026-11-11, after issue #7 (lone LaTeX symbols written as their character, ≧/≦ in a Traditional document; before it: 33 and 19 errors). errors/ref_chars are ocr_eval.py's total (incl. 1 text-layer character in no Block). wall_seconds is the whole CLI run including model load. peak_vram_mib is the whole card, which has about 1 GB of desktop use; it was measured before issue #7 and not again (the change adds no GPU work).

reproduce: PDF_OCR_SAMPLE_PDF="/path/to/台灣人壽解約金 115.09.23.pdf" uv run pytest -m gpu tests/test_e2e.py   # or: uv run pdf_ocr.py "<pdf>" -o out --pages 38-58 --reader minicpm && uv run ocr_eval.py "<pdf>" out/<stem>.json
